description: This file defines a React functional component called PostForm which serves as a form interface for creating or editing travel posts. It manages various state variables for post attributes such as title, content, tags, locations, images, tips, author, and status. The component includes functions for handling user inputs, dynamic addition/removal of tags, locations, tips, and images, and handles form submission by invoking a callback with the composed post data. The form consists of sections for basic information, metadata & details, and actions.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a new tag to the tags list if the input is non-empty and not already present.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a tag from the tags list based on its value.

methods.name: addLoc
methods.description: Adds a new location to the locations list if the input is non-empty and not already present.

methods.name: removeLoc
methods.description: Removes a location from the locations list based on its value.

methods.name: addTip
methods.description: Adds a new travel tip to the tips list with optional author.

methods.name: removeTip
methods.description: Removes a travel tip from the tips list based on its index.

methods.name: onImagesChange
methods.description: Updates the images state with new images selected via the ImageUploader component.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Handles form submission, invoking the provided onSubmit callback with the current post data, manages submission state.
